inputs: Frozen M1 two recorded RNG bundles, B4 final native measured map and 50 observed event labels; M2 independent 3D source-condition reference events
2D_probability_qualification: NOT_QUALIFIED_AS_PID_EVENT_PROBABILITY; occupied cell centre frequency has no ppm, source release/time/sensor operator differences remain

direct_raw_event_proxy.receivers: native B4 robot position converted with float32 native origin and 0.25m grid
direct_raw_event_proxy.observations: same 50 frozen native block labels, five per each of ten distinct stops; all positive
direct_raw_event_proxy.zero_one_rule: retain exact 0 and 1; impossible events yield -infinity log score; no clipping
direct_raw_event_proxy.finite_step_sensitivity: fixed p=(200*h+.5)/201 for both variants, sensitivity only; native unblurred h approximate integer k/200, blurred h is weighted pseudo-count, not beta posterior from actual events

M2_3D_controls.actual_PID_receiver: same physical service xyz/time and original one-message block, fixed p=(k+.5)/3 over two reference realizations
M2_3D_controls.same_2D_grid_receiver_PID: same physical service time, native robot cell centre at original sensor z, raw 3D threshold .1ppm; fixed p=(k+.5)/3 over two references

comparison_reporting: per each of 50 blocks and 10 correlated stops, exact aggregate log/Brier/native scores; labels and source roles known because this is posthoc diagnostic
inference_boundary: If 2D raw-event proxy also favors wrong, observed-map accumulation is not required for that proxy ordering; do not infer it is unnecessary for B4 full-system failure under an unqualified PID operator
next_call_permission: No fresh forward or realization authorized by this read-only subtask; next experiment proposal only
